brief:
Four Palestinians were killed and others wounded during Israeli military operations in Gaza, the Shehab Wire reported. The deaths occurred as the agency documented what it described as ongoing breaches by occupying forces across the territory.

The incident adds to the toll of casualties reported in recent operations. Israeli military activity has continued at various locations throughout Gaza, with reports indicating persistent engagement in different areas of the enclave. The specific circumstances surrounding each of the four deaths remain under investigation, though witnesses at the scene confirmed multiple casualties from the strikes.
